svg.title: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8 starter board: module, buttons, headers, I2C sensor, Qwiic port and RGB LED
svg.desc: The ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8 module U1. Its 3V3 pin is on the +3V3 rail with a 10 µF capacitor C4 and a 100 nF capacitor C5 to ground, and its ground pins go to ground. EN has a 10 kΩ pull-up R4 to +3V3, a 1 µF capacitor C6 to ground, a RESET button SW1 to ground and an ESD diode D3 to ground. IO0 has a 10 kΩ pull-up R5, a BOOT button SW2 to ground and an ESD diode D4. IO3 has a 10 kΩ pull-up R6. IO48 has a 10 kΩ pull-up R7, a USER button SW3 to ground and an ESD diode D5. TXD0 (IO43) and RXD0 (IO44) go to nets TXD0 and RXD0, and with EN, IO0, +3V3 and ground they reach the 2 × 3 programming header J2 (pin 1 EN, 2 +3V3, 3 TXD0, 4 GND, 5 RXD0, 6 IO0). IO19 and IO20 are the nets D− and D+ from the USB sheet. IO8 is SDA and IO9 is SCL, each with a 2.2 kΩ pull-up (R8, R9) to +3V3; the bus goes to the temperature and humidity sensor U4 (with a 100 nF capacitor C7 on its supply) and to the 4-pin Qwiic connector J3 (pin 1 GND, 2 +3V3, 3 SDA, 4 SCL). IO10 to IO15 go to the SPI header J4 as CS, MOSI, SCK, MISO, RST and IRQ, with +3V3 and ground. IO39, IO40 and IO41 drive the red, green and blue cathodes of a common-anode RGB LED D6 through 1 kΩ resistors R10 to R12; the anode is on +3V3.
svg.text: IO35–IO37, IO45, IO46 and all other pins not connected
